changelog: Two oversized modules are now folders, keeping the same import paths so no caller changed: `intentDictionary` (993 lines) splits into types / intent data / bilingual explanations / matching, and `fraudSentinel` (1001 lines) into types / pattern vocabulary / rule pack / alert copy / engine, each behind an `index.ts`. Every moved block was diffed byte-for-byte against the original. The changelog chain is now trimmed to one release back so the update note stays readable. Previous release: modular Android structure - `data/model/Models.kt` split per model group and `data/api/ApiInterfaces.kt` per API surface, with the system-level helpers lifted out of DashboardScreen and PhoneDoctorScreen.
